properties.label: Twelve-row ledger sheet
properties.text: Frame a sheet containing twelve aligned rows, with a narrow title, small document metadata, row numbers, dotted leaders, a right-aligned value column and a thin print band closing the sheet.

properties.label: Serif title and tabular values
properties.text: Use a narrow serif title, small metadata, faded row indices and tabular monospace values, with exact baseline and final-digit alignment.

properties.label: Warm paper and faded red
properties.text: Use warm gray board, white paper, charcoal text and faded red row numbers.

properties.label: Dotted leaders and minute halftone
properties.text: Keep dotted-leader density exact and confine minute halftone detail to the print treatment.

properties.label: Subtle paper-edge depth
properties.text: Let subtle paper edges provide the physical depth.

properties.label: Still qualified reading surface
properties.text: Keep the ledger primarily still and retain any sample or historical-data label at every breakpoint.

properties.label: Qualified ledger data
properties.text: Retain the source and date qualifier and never invent counts to make the sheet appear authoritative.

properties.label: Row legibility acceptance
properties.text: Verify that every row can be read at mobile scale and that the last digits remain aligned.
